_comment: Copy to config.json and edit. Every key is optional. Priority: CLI flags > NFC_BRIDGE_* env vars > config.json > defaults.
_port_note: Explicit serial port. If set, vid/pid/description_contains are ignored. Comment out (delete) to auto-detect.
_vid_pid_note: USB vendor/product id filter. Accepts hex ('0x072F') or decimal. Used only when 'port' is not set.
_description_note: Case-insensitive substring match against the port description/manufacturer/product.
_allowed_origins_note: CORS allowlist for the web console. Exact origins only (scheme+host+port), no wildcards. Defaults cover the Vite dev/preview ports. Add your console's real origin here if you serve it elsewhere. The bridge listens on 127.0.0.1 only, so the console must run on the SAME PC.
_debug_token_note: Leave empty to DISABLE POST /debug/scan entirely (recommended in normal use). Set to a random string to enable it for testing; callers must then send that string as an 'X-Debug-Token' header or '?token=' query param, in addition to being on the local machine.
